column1: # Doctor extension API 1. Base and overlay extensions update independently of
# the coordinator, so every row must work against an older and a newer dot:
# - helpers are only ever added; a helper newer than an extension's oldest
#   supported dot is probed with `declare -F` before use (dot_doctor_info,
# - an empty DETAIL renders like an omitted one (older coordinators print an
# - each extension has a deadline (DOT_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT seconds, default 60;
#   0 disables it); past it the coordinator stops the extension and reports
#   it as timed out. Older coordinators have no deadline, so an extension
#   must not rely on being stopped.

column4: records an informational row that is never counted; newer than the other helpers, so probe `declare -F dot_doctor_info` and fall back to dot_doctor_ok

attaches one list item to the closest verdict row filed before it (rendered as an indented "- TEXT" line; past five, the rest fold into "+N more"; an empty TEXT is dropped; with no verdict row before it, the coordinator reports an invalid result); newer than dot_doctor_info, so probe `declare -F dot_doctor_item` and fall back to joining items into the row's DETAIL

attaches one next step to the closest verdict row filed before it (rendered as a "→ TEXT" line after any items; an empty TEXT is dropped; with no verdict row before it, the coordinator reports an invalid result); newer than dot_doctor_info, so probe `declare -F dot_doctor_hint` and fall back to appending the step to the row's DETAIL
